title: A Holistic Functionalization Approach to Optimizing Imperative Tensor Programs in Deep Learning
problem: Imperative tensor programs (PyTorch) with tensor-level mutations introduce side effects that prevent deep learning compilers from effectively applying operator fusion optimizations. Previous approaches either fail to eliminate these side effects or require manual programmer intervention.
motivation: Efficient compilation of domain-specific operators in deep learning is critical for model accuracy and performance, but imperative programming constructs with mutations block automatic optimization.
method: TensorSSA converts imperative tensor programs—code that modifies data in place, like PyTorch—into functional form, where new data is created instead of mutating existing tensors. Mutations (direct changes to existing data) prevent compilers from fusing operations together (combining multiple operations into one efficient operation), which is a key optimization technique. By eliminating mutations, TensorSSA enables operator fusion across control flow boundaries (if statements, loops, etc.), an optimization scope that previous approaches couldn't achieve.
key_novelty: TensorSSA automatically transforms tensor programs from imperative form (code that modifies data in place) to functional form (code that creates new data), enabling operator fusion optimizations across control flow structures that previous methods couldn't handle.
contributions: TensorSSA intermediate representation for eliminating tensor-level mutations in imperative tensor programs
TensorSSA conversion algorithm enabling functionalization across control flow boundaries
Speedup of 1.79X (1.34X average) over state-of-the-art approaches on representative deep learning tasks
primary_theme: Compiler-based operator fusion for imperative tensor programs
